summary_1line: Bhishma tells of Chirakarin, who delays killing his mother as ordered by his father, and his thoughtful hesitation ultimately prevents a grave sin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Chirakarin stands motionless with a raised weapon beside his silent mother, lost in deep moral reflection within a forest hermitage.
The sage Gautama returns to his hermitage in anguish, fearing his son has killed Ahalya, while the forest path lies quiet around him.
Chirakarin drops his weapon and prostrates before his returning father as his ashamed mother stands nearby in the hermitage.
